items.label: Profile
items.content: Growth and performance marketing leader with 9+ years driving paid acquisition and measurable revenue outcomes for SaaS, retail, and consumer brands. Repeatedly cut customer-acquisition cost and cost-per-lead through data-driven, multi-channel campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, paired with strong attribution, reporting, and marketing automation.
